assertion.statement: For the fixed non-CM elliptic curve E/Q, there is n≥2 with 1+2^n M2(Z2) contained in the actual2-adic Galois image; in particular it contains the scalar(1+2^n)I and the stated elementary matrix elements.
assertion.objects: The actual Tate module T2(E) and its G_Q image for the fixed curve in the RC construction.
assertion.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve overQ without geometric complex multiplication; the current fixed curve has nonintegral rational j=35152/9.
assertion.quantifiers: There exists one n for this fixed E, usable in each subsequent permitted auxiliary-field construction.
assertion.parameter_range: The characteristic-zero2-adic representation, despite full rational2-torsion.
assertion.uniformity: n depends on E; no uniform bound over all elliptic curves or auxiliary Kummer extensions is asserted.
assertion.constants: n may be enlarged to be at least2; no numerical value is supplied.
assertion.normalizations: A congruence subgroup in GL2(Z2), not residual mod2 surjectivity.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not itself prove the ring-class annihilator, radical-fixing commutator subgroup, or Kummer translation lattice; those are separate deductions.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the non-CM curve, apply openness, then choose one congruence depth and the required Galois preimages.
